content.short: Synapse Protocol enables cross-chain communication and cross-blockchain token transfers.
content.description: Synapse Protocol (formerly Nerve Finance) enables the creation of tokens that can be transferred across multiple blockchain networks. Its cross-messaging capability allows different blockchains to understand one another and cooperate, enabling interoperability across diverse ecosystems. As a bridge built on an optimistic verification model, its transactions are regarded as valid until proven otherwise, providing a straightforward framework for cross-chain activity and collaboration between disparate networks.
